prompt:
Five separate fantasy heroes stand in five separate cells of this picture. Each one performs its OWN special move, described in its own paragraph below; the five are independent: never copy one hero's movement, pose or prop onto another. The camera is fixed and does not move, zoom or pan. Left and right in this description are the screen's left and right. Every hero faces screen right; its target is an enemy just outside its own cell to the right. Every hero performs its move IN PLACE: it stays over its own spot inside its own cell, ends where it started, never leaves its cell, never touches or overlaps another hero, its weapon never reaches into another hero's cell, and it keeps its own size, design, colours, outline and weapon exactly as in the image, in the near-side view facing screen right with the head looking forward to screen right. Each move is one continuous action that ends on its last pose and holds it; no return to the starting stance.
1. The armoured knight with the red crest (far left) bends his knees low, grips the hammer haft in both hands and pulls the stone hammer back beside his hip toward screen left, his hips and shoulders turned back; then his hips turn first and his shoulders follow as he sweeps the hammer level at waist height, parallel to the ground, across the front of his body from screen left to screen right; he ends with the hammer on the screen-right side of his body, his arms stretched and his body leaning after the hammer, the hammer head still inside his own cell, and holds that pose.
2. The hooded archer (second from left) bends his knees with the bow held low; then he jumps straight up in place about a third of his height, leaning back with his knees tucked; in the air he raises the bow and aims it straight to screen right, pulls the bare string back to his cheek with two EMPTY fingers and releases it; he lands back on the same spot with his knees bending and holds the pose with the bow still aimed to screen right. He has NO arrow anywhere: no arrow on the string, no arrow in his hand, no arrow in the air.
3. The pale floating woman with the cape (middle) never touches the ground. She pulls her forward open hand back to her shoulder and swings her other hand back behind her, her cape folding in; then she pushes the forward open palm straight out to screen right at chest height, her body leaning after it; she holds the arm fully stretched while her body is pushed back a short distance by the force, her hair and cape blowing back toward screen left, and holds that pose.
4. The red-haired woman with the double axe (second from right) plants the butt of the axe haft on the ground beside her front foot on the screen-right side, the axe head up; holding the haft with one hand, she raises her other clenched fist high into the sky, puffs out her chest and throws her head back; she opens her mouth wide in a fierce war cry, her shoulders and wild hair shaking; she holds this pose, fist raised high, the other hand gripping the upright axe.
5. The stone giant with the black beard (far right) shifts his weight onto his rear leg and lifts the knee of his front leg high, his huge arms spread out for balance; then he stamps that big stone foot down hard on the same spot of his ground line, his knees bending and his shoulders dropping; he holds a low wide crouch, both fists clenched. His small bald head, glowing eyes, black beard and gold beard rings stay visible and face screen right in every frame; his body never turns away from the viewer.
No arrow, no fire, no lava, no light, no glow, no aura, no beam, no sound wave, no explosion, no ring, no projectile, no dust, no debris, no crack in the ground, no slash arc, no motion trail, no afterimage and no effect of any kind is drawn; only the bodies move. The flat solid pure magenta background stays unchanged and fixed in every frame: no scenery, no ground, no shadows, no text, no grid, no camera shake.
